Definition: from G575 and G5055; to complete entirely, i.e. consummate:--finish.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to finish completely, to bring something to its end. James says sin, when it is finished, brings forth death, and Jesus says on the third day He will be perfected, His work brought to its appointed completion.
TheologicalSignificance: What is finished matters: sin finished is death, and Christ's work finished is life.
